svg.aria-label: Three-panel diagram: a ring of atoms with a sealed central cavity has exposed dots on both its outer surface and its inner cavity wall; connecting dots within a cutoff distance forms two disconnected rings, since the gap between them is wider than the cutoff; only the ring reachable from a seeded extreme dot is kept, the other is cleared.

text.tspan: Both rings of dots passed the atom-
yet marks the inner ring as a sealed
ring closes on itself; so does the
inner one — nothing bridges the gap.
Only the component holding a seed
is real exterior. The pocket's dots
never reach one, so exposed is set
to false for every one of them.
